title: 2022 CODATA: proton mag. mom. is 1.410 606 795 45 × 10^−26 J T^-1
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives proton mag. mom. as 1.410 606 795 45 × 10^−26 J T^-1, with uncertainty 0.000 000 000 60 × 10^−26.
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives proton mag. mom. as 1.410 606 795 45 × 10^−26 J T^-1, with uncertainty 0.000 000 000 60 × 10^−26. The row is not marked exact. The uncertainty is the uncertainty printed on that row. The ASCII file does not split it into statistical and systematic parts. This is the proton magnetic moment in J T^-1, not the ratio to the nuclear magneton.
